text:
morgan: Quick async standup — kernel/batching/KV perf mini-check.

morgan: Yesterday: landed the hotpatch for KV eviction jitter, added a small telemetry label so we can split by shard. Ran a 1h microbench on canary.
lee: Nice. Any diffs in p95?
morgan: p50 about the same, p95 down ~6% on canary vs baseline. Rough numbers in case useful: `baseline p95 84ms -> canary p95 79ms` on 4k requests.
anya: 🚀 good. Did you hit any regressions in throughput?
morgan: Throughput held. One weird thing: a small spike in CPU on slot handoff that correlated with high KV lookup rate. I left a log snippet below.
morgan: ```
2026-03-16T07:12:11Z INFO slot_handoff shard=7 handoff_ms=112 cpu_pct=74
2026-03-16T07:12:12Z INFO kv_lookup shard=7 keys=128 latency_ms=3.6
2026-03-16T07:12:13Z WARN prefetch_miss shard=7 keys=12
```
ravi: That prefetch_miss line worries me — could be our LRU window size too small for that workload. Which config did you use?
morgan: Default prefetch.window=32. Tried bump to 64 and reran one short sweep; misses dropped ~40%.
lee: Can you push the config change to the canary and mark the experiment in the dashboard? I want to compare with earlier run graphs.
morgan: Will do in a minute. Also opened a tiny PR with the config flag and a comment explaining the risk. Link: https://git.redwood.ai/pr/4129 (please thumbs up if ok).
talia: @morgan quick ping: does that PR change any runtime ABI or just config?
morgan: Just config flag + a guard comment. No ABI.
anya: Blockers?
morgan: One blocker: I saw an intermittent test failure in bench harness where microbatching would occasionally merge two unrelated requests (rare). I can repro locally but haven't traced root cause. Test id: bench/microbatch/repro-102.
ravi: Hmm — could be ordering in the batch-collector when slot steals happen. I can take a look this afternoon.
lee: If you can paste a minimal repro command that would help.
morgan: repro command: `./tools/run_bench --pattern microburst --seed 102 --shards 8 --verify-order`
morgan: Also, CI bot posted a flaky test yesterday: `ci-bot: flaky: microbatch-merge (job 7821)` — I added a comment linking the bench id.
ci-bot: Test job 7821 rerun scheduled by morgan at 2026-03-16T08:05:00Z.
talia: For today I'm planning: 1) push canary config change, 2) attach new telemetry tag to the canary runs, 3) pair with ravi on the repro.
anya: I'll finish the perf dashboard tiles for KV hit/miss and add a per-shard p95 panel. Should be done by EOD.
ravi: I'll dig into the microbatch order edge case after lunch, focusing on slot-handovers + collector queue.
lee: I'll review the PR and the new telemetry tag. Also will run the longer 6h sweep overnight against canary cluster.
morgan: Thanks. If anyone sees new regressions, ping me directly. Otherwise I'll update the PR with the canary link and the bench artifacts when the run finishes. :thumbsup:
